title: Jubilant Pharmova eyes $150 million through rupee debt sale, bankers say
summary: Jubilant Pharmova plans to raise around Rs 14 billion ($150 million) through a three-year rupee bond offering to fund capital expenditure and refinance project-related liabilities at overseas subsidiaries. The proposed issuance, rated AA+ by India Ratings,...

contentHtml:
Mumbai: Jubilant Pharmova is set to raise funds through a rupee bond offering, primarily to invest in capital expenditure, two merchant bankers said on Friday.

The company is engaged in specialty pharmaceuticals, contract development and manufacturing, generics, drug discovery and proprietary novel drug businesses. It plans to raise around 14 billion rupees (around $150 million) through the sale of three-year bonds with bullet maturity, the bankers added.

They requested anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to media, while the company did not reply to a Reuters email seeking comment.

The notes are rated AA+ by India Ratings, and the company could tap the debt market before the end of next month.

The rating agency expects the business profile of the firm to strengthen further over the medium term, supported by increasing contribution from recently commissioned capacities.

Jubilant made capital expenditure of 14.5 billion rupees in the last financial year and plans to use the proceeds from the planned debt issuance on capex and to refinance project-related liabilities at overseas subsidiaries.

The funds would go towards its operating entities in North America, India Ratings noted.
